text:
maria: Heads up — the quickstart PR I pulled in broke the Hello quickstart auth instructions. Users hitting deploy get a 401 during first run.

sam: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Which doc and snippet?

maria: docs/quickstart/hello-python.md — env var example uses OFFICIAL_API_KEY but our examples and samples expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. Current snippet in the doc: ```
export OFFICIAL_API_KEY="sk-..."
```
That mismatch is causing the starter app to start without credentials.

oliver: CI e2e shows `401 Unauthorized: missing api key` coming from starter-hello when it calls the API. It reads os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY') but the doc told users to set OFFICIAL_API_KEY.

sam: Plan: (1) change the env var example to REDWOOD_API_KEY across quickstart pages, (2) update python/js snippets to use the SDK4 client init, (3) add a tiny migration note for folks coming from older docs. I'll draft a tiny PR.

docs-rev: Also the sidebar link for Auth points at /auth/setup-v1 — that should be /auth/setup. I can file a follow-up or add to the same PR.

sam: Opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/732. Changes: env var rename, python snippet update, curl example tweak, and sidebar link fix. cc @maria for verification.

deploy-bot: [ci/docs] build started for branch docs-fix/quickstart-auth (build 8342)

maria: Quick check on staging: page built but python import is still the old `from redwood import Client` in one spot. SDK4 examples should use `from redwood import RedwoodClient`.

sam: Good catch — updating example to: ```
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```
That'll align with the starter repo.

oliver: Re-ran the local starter after that change — auth flow works, starter app successfully calls the hosted API. Local smoke tests pass.

deploy-bot: [ci/docs] build 8342 completed — status=success. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-python

docs-rev: Please add a one-liner migration note near the top: "Migrating from SDK3? Update imports and client initialization — see /migration/sdk3-to-sdk4." Also fix the broken anchor to the auth section (was pointing to v1).

maria: Added a nits comment about wording — avoid the word 'secret' in a public sample sentence and prefer 'API key'. Once nits are fixed, I'm happy to approve. After merge please trigger a sample-app deploy so we can validate end-to-end.

sam: Addressed nits, pushed commit, and merged after CI green. Triggering sample-app deploy now. @deploy-bot deploy sample-app/starter-hello to staging.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for sample-app/starter-hello (build 210). status=queued.

maria: Verified the live starter after deploy — the README and quickstart now match and the auth flow works on first run. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks everyone, I'll follow up with a short changelog entry and link the migration doc.
